blocks.x: Why? Why did you feel that way?
Because -- I don't know. I just wanted to do something on my own, because I had had a band before. I had a band (inaudible) had a band at Little Rock. (Inaudible).
So I thought I'd try it, you know.
Was it that you wanted to play your own music? I mean, that you had your ideas?
No, it's just something I just wanted to do and just --
Yeah. Okay, "The next move I made was to organize a small band of my own in which several of my fellow members in the Moten band joined me," naturally. Wow. In what way is that not true (inaudible)?
